funeral_wishes.title: Funeral Wishes
funeral_wishes.description: Service, burial or cremation preferences, and people to notify.
funeral_wishes.draftBody:
I would like my funeral and memorial arrangements to follow these preferences:

- Ceremony style: [religious / non-religious / private / public]
- Location preference: [place of worship / funeral home / other]
- Burial or cremation: [preference]
- People to notify first: [names]
- Music, readings, or other details: [notes]

Please also consider: [any additional wishes].

executor.title: Instructions for My Executor
executor.description: Practical guidance for the person settling your affairs.
executor.draftBody:
Dear Executor,

When the time comes, please start with these steps:

1. Locate my will and important documents in: [location / folder]
2. Contact my lawyer: [name and phone]
3. Notify close family: [names]
4. Secure access to accounts and property: [notes]
5. Review outstanding bills and benefits: [notes]

Priority contacts:
- [Name] — [role] — [phone/email]

Additional guidance: [notes].

power_of_attorney.title: Instructions for My Power of Attorney
power_of_attorney.description: What to do if someone needs to act on your behalf.
power_of_attorney.draftTitle: Instructions for my power of attorney
power_of_attorney.draftBody:
Dear Power of Attorney,

If you need to act on my behalf, please follow this guidance:

- Scope of authority: [financial / medical / both]
- Preferred decision approach: [notes]
- Accounts or institutions to contact first: [list]
- People to consult before major decisions: [names]
- Limits or preferences I want respected: [notes]

Documents you may need are stored in: [location].

Additional notes: [notes].

incapacitation.title: In the Event of My Incapacitation
incapacitation.description: Care wishes and responsibilities if you cannot decide for yourself.
incapacitation.draftBody:
If I become unable to manage my own affairs, please follow these instructions:

1. Contact my primary doctor: [name and phone]
2. Notify my power of attorney / key person: [name and phone]
3. Access medical and insurance information in: [location]
4. Care preferences: [notes]
5. Temporary household / financial priorities: [notes]

Emergency contacts:
- [Name] — [relationship] — [phone]

Additional guidance: [notes].

pay_and_cancel.title: What to Pay and What to Cancel
pay_and_cancel.description: Bills to keep paying and subscriptions or services to cancel.
pay_and_cancel.draftTitle: What to pay and what to cancel
pay_and_cancel.draftBody:
Please use this list to manage ongoing payments and cancellations:

Continue paying:
- [Bill / provider] — due [date] — account info in [location]
- [Bill / provider] — due [date] — account info in [location]

Cancel or pause:
- [Subscription / service] — how to cancel: [notes]
- [Subscription / service] — how to cancel: [notes]

Where to find statements and login details: [location].

Additional notes: [notes].

crypto_access.title: How to Access My Crypto
crypto_access.description: Where to find wallets, exchanges, and how to begin recovery.
crypto_access.draftBody:
Use this guidance to locate and secure my crypto assets. Do not share recovery phrases over email or chat.

- Exchanges I use: [names]
- Hardware / software wallets: [names]
- Where recovery materials are stored: [secure location]
- First person to involve: [name]
- Important warnings: [notes]

Steps:
1. [First step]
2. [Second step]
3. [Third step]

Additional notes: [notes].
